items.q: Which SSL certificate do I need?
items.a: For a blog, portfolio or small business site a Domain Validated certificate such as PositiveSSL DV is enough. If you run several subdomains (shop., mail., app.) choose a Wildcard certificate. Choose a business-validated certificate such as GeoTrust True BusinessID when you want your verified company name shown in the certificate details.

items.q: Is SSL already included with my hosting?
items.a: Yes — every GlobalHostia hosting plan includes a free SSL certificate. Paid certificates add higher warranty, organisation validation, wildcard coverage and a site seal for extra customer trust.

items.q: How long does it take to issue a certificate?
items.a: Domain Validated certificates are usually issued within minutes after you confirm domain ownership by email, DNS or file. Organisation validation takes longer because the certificate authority verifies your company details.

items.q: Can you install the certificate for me?
items.a: Yes. If your website is hosted with us our support team can install and configure the certificate for you. For sites hosted elsewhere we send you the files and step-by-step instructions.

items.q: What happens when my certificate expires?
items.a: We remind you before expiry. Renew from your client area and the new certificate is issued and installed so visitors never see a security warning.

items.q: What is the difference between a VPS and a dedicated server?
